subject.title: fix(cron): honor AbortSignal in waitForActiveCronTaskRuns poll

question: Which accepted gateway lifecycle transition, if any, should cancel an in-progress cron task-drain wait before its one-second deadline?
rationale: Current main coalesces or ignores ordinary repeated restart requests, while the PR introduces a new cancellation mode without connecting it to a defined lifecycle event; the owner must choose the safe semantic boundary before implementation.

options.title: Define a cancellable restart transition
options.body: Specify the accepted upgrade or shutdown transition that aborts the drain, preserve required reset cleanup, and land focused lifecycle coverage.

options.title: Keep the bounded drain policy
options.body: Retain the current one-second bounded drain and close this PR because repeated restart signals are intentionally coalesced or ignored.

recommendation.title: Define a cancellable restart transition
recommendation.body: Specify the accepted upgrade or shutdown transition that aborts the drain, preserve required reset cleanup, and land focused lifecycle coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current cron restart-reset sequence that the proposed cancellation behavior would alter.
